propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES = frozenset({'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'}) with no runtime configuration option, while DC reconciler reads resolved_statuses from config.
A Cloud tenant using non-standard resolved-status names (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete', "Won't Do") has issues misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED.
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses: list[str] with default ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'], coerced from [tool.rebar.jira] via _as_str_list and REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.
probe.py classify_probe_response must resolve the configured jira.resolved_statuses at classify time, falling back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when unset, empty, or malformed.
Custom resolved_statuses config must take precedence over the default; an explicitly empty list must fall back to the default, not bind an empty set.
